To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a class of particle based absorber, transferable hyperbolytic metamaterial particles (TMHPM), is introduced.
a class of materials called transferable hyperbolically metamaterial particles (TMMP) can be made into a broadband, selective, and omnidirectional absorber that is highly flexible and transferable.
a new class of broadband, tunable, omnidirectional absorber, transferrable HNTs (THMMPs), is proposed and shown to exhibit near perfect absorption from 1,000 nm to over 1,900 nm when closely packed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of broadband, omnidirectional absorbers that can be transferred to more practical substrates.
the development and demonstration of a new class of materials, called transferable hyper-bolic metamaterial particles, for the design of broadband, selective, tunable and omnidirectional absorbers.
the development of broadband absorbers with a wide range of applications in light detection, energy conversion, and camouflage.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
THMMP are a new type of absorber that can be used in a wide variety of applications and that can be made from many different types of materials and geometries.
the THMMPs provide a unique and highly flexible solution to broadband, omnidirectional absorption in a standalone, transferable system.
we introduce a new class of particle absorber that can be easily fabricated and transferred to more desirable, flexible, and low cost substrates.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated broadband absorption from standalone particle systems and that these particles can be transferred onto mechanically flexible, thin, low cost substrates.
we introduce a new class of particle absorber that can be transferred onto a variety of substrates and show broadband absorption that is highly tunable and selective.
broadband absorbers can be designed from a class of particles that are highly flexible, thin, and can be easily transferred to more desirable, low cost substrates for a variety of applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
THMMPs can be used as an alternative to planar materials for many applications.
broadband absorbers with high performance can be realized in particle based systems that overcome the challenges of planar materials.
broadband, omnidirectional absorption from a standalone system can be achieved using a simple design and a variety of material systems and geometrical arrangements.
